hero.title:
Crooked House
Crooked outside, extraordinary inside
hero.description: A stay beyond the ordinary, in a house with a unique character, designed for those who love to experience something truly special.
about.headline: A characterful village home for slow, sunlit days
about.p1: Set in the quiet village of Grandola ed Uniti, just above Menaggio on Lake Como, Crooked House is a lovingly restored one-bedroom apartment. White plaster walls, exposed wooden beams, and cool tiled floors keep the atmosphere calm and airy even on the warmest afternoons.
about.p2: You'll have the whole apartment to yourself  a **private entrance**, a **comfortable living room**, a **fully equipped kitchen**, and a **garden framed by the mountains**.
about.p3: **4 guests** · **1 bedroom** + **1 sofa bed** · **Private garden** · **No smoking** · **No pets**
gallery.headline: Every corner, thoughtfully considered
gallery.body: From the cosy bedroom to the mountain-framed garden, take a look around before you arrive.
amenities.headline: Everything you need to unwind
amenities.body: **Crooked House** has everything you need for a pleasant, comfortable, and worry-free stay.
amenities.list: Coffee machines for espresso, moka, and American-style coffee
Flat-screen TV with access to your favourite streaming services
Free cot (120 × 60 cm), available on request
Private garden with table and parasol
Laundry room with washing machine, dryer, and large sink with hot water
Free private garage, suitable for a small or medium-sized car
explore.headline: Explore the area
explore.body: **Crooked House** is the ideal base for discovering Lake Como and its mountains, blending **relaxation, nature, sport, and culture.** Its location makes it easy to reach enchanting towns such as **Menaggio, Tremezzina, Varenna, and Bellagio,** as well as countless trekking, hiking, and e-bike routes. You can even extend your experience across the border to **Lugano,** in Switzerland. A stay designed for enjoying the territory through its villages, historic villas, lakeside landscapes, and alpine views.
stay.headline: Discover the spaces
services.headline: Services and thoughtful touches
services.body:
Every stay is designed to offer you comfort, hospitality, and the warmth of feeling at home. If you're travelling by motorbike, you can use a **dedicated parking space right at the property.**
On request, Mara will be happy to prepare **breakfasts and meals made with care,** turning simple ingredients into delightful moments to savour. Her experience is enriched by her **qualification as a Pastry Chef from the Italian Academy of Milan,** her **S.A.B.** certification, and **H.A.C.C.P.** training from the Lombardy Region.
All the information about how to use the service is available on site.
